parts:
I am tryubg to use it to identify QTLs for a wheat project ,using a
RILs , the genetic map it gave out is quite weird,which is more than
5000cM,and I run est.rf (),and est.map(),checkAlleles(), it shows:No
apparent problems.
Anyone got the same problem ?

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Genetic Map
parts:
I would look at whether individual intervals are really long or whether the entire map is expanded. A couple of poorly behaved markers can result in the adjacent intervals being > 500 cM.

karl
